This is in nearly the same place as the observation of the same species that I posted about a year ago. This time the occurrence seemed larger. The tallest individual is about 30 feet tall and there are quite a few smaller plants in the immediate vicinity. All are on a hillside leading down to a trail. I did not seem there were any on the other side of the trail, or anywhere else I looked in the Thain Forest of NYBG. No evidence of fruiting. No other sumacs in vicinity either.
